BrochureContent.Content:
Quillsen are delighted to present to the market a superb, conveniently and centrally located home, This modern, spacious two bedroom duplex with secure parking included has been loving cared for and upgraded by the current home owner. Accommodation is laid out across two floors, it essentially comprises Entrance hall, Living Room and Kitchen / Dining Room all at entry level, together with Landing, 2 double bedrooms, (master en suite) and shower room, all being set across the upper floor. This property makes an ideal starter home and the shrewd investor can benefit from market rent.

LOCATION
Centrally located here in the heart of Drogheda which is superbly served by regular scheduled commuter train and bus services.

Drogheda, adjacent to the M1, is the largest town in the Republic of Ireland being predominately located in County Louth with its southern environs extending into County Meath. The location is highly convenient with an abundance of essential services and facilities on the doorstep as well as a wide selection of `retail therapy`, sporting, recreational, employment, financial, educational and spiritual offerings, amongst others. A port town of great character built on the banks of the River Boyne, with many great eateries and bars, there is a fantastic atmosphere to Drogheda. 

Moreover, located nearby is the World Heritage Site of Brú na Bóinne, Ireland`s richest archaeological landscape, famous for the spectacular prehistoric passage tombs of Knowth, Newgrange and Dowth which were built circa 3200BC. Designated a World Heritage Site by UNESCO, one of only three in all of Ireland, these ceremonial structures are among the most important Neolithic sites in the world and contain the largest collection of megalithic art in Western Europe.

Don`t just take our word for it, if you haven`t done so already, why not visit and experience Drogheda and the wider area first hand for yourself?

VIEWING
An early inspection of this property comes highly recommended by the selling agent. To arrange a viewing, please reply via this listing or telephone 046 9022100.

This enables and ensures that we provide a superior property service throughout Counties Dublin and Meath, as well as into the adjoining parts of Counties Louth, Cavan, Offaly, Kildare and Wicklow. Our name is synonymous with the sale of residential properties, both urban and rural, as well as development land, farm and country properties. We offer a FREE no-obligation sales appraisal and valuation for those who are selling or those that are contemplating selling.
